name: desktop-worker-port
goal: Keep one automatically selected Desktop browser port across the runner, server and worker processes without adopting another server

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Full ordinary check at 70fc3435d passed root, package, Reports, Planning and Desktop unit/native/build checks, then 203 of 204 browser cases failed with connection refusal at changing worker ports. Config chose a new free port in each process.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard preview refusal matrix covered explicit ports and foreign-server refusal but never auto-selected ports across processes. Extend it with fresh parent/worker configuration imports in both modes and a real ordinary read-only browser smoke flow.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At 05a299df9 both modes fail the same assertion: fresh worker imports choose different base URLs from their parent. The four existing named-port and foreign-server controls remain passing.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Publish the selected port in the runner environment before workers spawn, while preserving explicit-port validation, server port forwarding and reuseExistingServer=false. Keep the cross-process matrix and real ordinary smoke flow in normal verification.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.

Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
